summary: The RTL tracks the previous value of enable instead of signal_in, causing an extra pulse when signal_in remains high.
reasoning: The reference updates previous_ref from signal_in (tb/pulse_tb.v:11), while the RTL updates previous from enable (rtl/pulse.v:6). On the second consecutive high signal_in cycle, the reference expects no pulse; the reported mismatch is consistent with this state-tracking error. The single-line change is likely sufficient, but it has not been independently validated.
